summary: Read the hub and its Context, then all 27 source pages whole (Review Layer's middle section was truncated in my first read; the passages I quote are from what I saw). Pattern: of 27 weak links, 13 are cut (nine with no reason on either page; two are pairs the hub already carries in the other direction, Hilaritas Generator and Symbiotic Skills; one is a proof-copy file; Flocking's label belongs to Kuramoto, not the hub), 5 get a label (README, Metaphor as Coupling Medium, The Cooperation Path, Palace Philosophies, Semantic Webcam, the last at low confidence), 4 are retyped (Trickster to mirrors, since the page says 'mirrors' in so many words; Buber to mirrors; FOUR PILLARS from enables to a labelled connects-to; Context Injection from couples-with to a labelled connects-to), and 5 stand as they are (Review Layer, McGilchrist, Fuller, Dovetail, Sidechain). The ceremonies and the Walk route to the hub through other pages already linked. One newcomer inbound proposed: CHILD deepens the hub, because the hub names CHILD for its holds-and-yields rule and CHILD says it. Could not settle: whether the FOUR PILLARS and Context Injection retypes are worth keeping over a cut (both rest on a companion page or a single passage); whether the Semantic Webcam sentence is more than a see-also; and the Fuller and Dovetail labels, which are the pages' own words but thin against the hub's specific claim of shared intent. I proposed no inbound links for the other newcomers; I found none that was genuine from the pages in this room.
